classifier.classifier: weighted closed-form ridge over trailing lag windows
classifier.feature: x[t-49:t], strictly trailing, x_t excluded (the label point)
classifier.label: 1 at every ledger event point (all 3 points of a burst), else 0
classifier.positive_class_weight: N_neg / N_pos, computed on the pooled training set
classifier.solver: weighted normal equations, np.linalg.solve, mirroring evaluation/benchmark_v02/trainers.fit_closed_form (intercept column last and unpenalized)
classifier.standardization: per series: (x - median) / (1.4826 * MAD) with both constants taken from that series' own P(training block); the same constants standardize the Query features

fallback.budget: may be taken at most once, and only after the primary spec fails the readability gate on the calibration Query
fallback.on_use: the chosen window freezes into the artifact; nothing else moves
